page.notes: Three columns of an alphabetical subject index (Doctores to Ecclesia). Many numbers and abbreviations are small and italic in the scan; several are uncertain and not marked with [?] here, notably the figures after "Ecclesiae Christi metamorphosis", "Ecclesiae cura", "Ecclesiae Dei dignitas" and the Greek heading "Δοξολογία", as well as "Ecclesiae quatenus communicandu", which may be cut off at the edge. The first column's last line runs over into the middle column ("contra Dominum non esse sapientiam, / nec consilium"). The final line "Ecclesia" is cut off at the bottom edge of the page. No page number or catchword is printed on this scan. The top-right and left edges show the neighbouring page and show-through, which are left out.
